item.text: {"0":"Across all four datasets, switch the existing two bidirectional Transformer blocks from pre-normalization to post-normalization (norm_first=False), retaining attention heads, 2× feed-forward width, GELU and residual connections. Normalizing each residual output may stabilize contextual representations with the incumbent's small normalized embeddings. Keep features, embeddings, history, masked-item loss and optimizer fixed; use the identical architecture in the predictor writer.","1":"Across all four datasets, increase only the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier from 0.8 to 0.9, preserving width 64 and input/output tying. Mirror position construction in prediction.","3":"Across all four datasets, reduce only the existing training-frequency input-feature amplitude from 0.04 to 0.02: scale visible item vectors by 1+0.02*tanh(z), using the same standardized log1p training-item counts. Keep padding and mask scales at one, checkpoint the feature buffer, and preserve embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer."}
